crossRefs.note: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of…
crossRefs.keyword: body and mind, by long bodily afflictions and mental distress

crossRefs.note: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.
crossRefs.keyword: body and mind, by long bodily afflictions and mental distress

crossRefs.note: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.
crossRefs.keyword: body and mind, by long bodily afflictions and mental distress

crossRefs.note: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.
crossRefs.keyword: body and mind, by long bodily afflictions and mental distress

crossRefs.note: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word.
The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.
I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

translations.web: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.
translations.bsb: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
translations.kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.
translations.asv: For I am become like a wine-skin in the smoke; Yet do I not forget thy statutes.
